title: Parody, Imitation, and Voice
grammar: Unpacking dense nominalized prose into dynamic verbal clauses and vice versa
goal: I can diagnose 'nominalitis' (terpeszkedő kifejezések / excessive nominal chains) in bureaucratic or pretentious prose.
I can unpack heavy nominalizations into crisp finite Hungarian verbs.
I can deliberately shift between dense academic style and vivid narrative style.
